_why_two_claims: AGREEMENT asks whether the engines compute the same thing; RECOVERY asks whether they compute the right thing. Neither implies the other.

truth.source: the fixture's data-generating process: the effect is 1.5 and the outcomes are missing at random given the covariate and arm

agreement.claim: both engines report the same MAR effect, SE, tipping point and complete-case comparator
agreement._note: Observed spread on the committed fixture: 0. harness/missing_examples.test.py checks the lower limit is zero at the tipping point (1e-8) and changes sign either side of it, that the effect moves by exactly the treated arm's missing fraction per unit of delta (1e-10), and that complete-case analysis is biased by more than 0.2 on average.

recovery.claim: the estimate is close to the fixture's

calibration.rule: about 1.3 times the measured 99th percentile miss, rounded up
calibration.limits: The tolerance separates the effect (1.5) from zero. A first fixture (600 patients, weaker missingness) left complete-case analysis nearly unbiased and the MAR estimate imprecise (miss 0.92). Measured by harness/missing_examples.test.py over seeds 0 to 99 (MALLARD_SEEDS=100); CI reruns it on seeds 0 to 49 (owner decision E5).
